txt: ...bloated corpse of the past, resurfacing?
...in hell and ancient sadness, brother. Ten thousand years later -- in front of the video rental. There is a warm breath on your face again. Everything is *okay* again.
Admit it, you just missed the quarter-light. The darkness on the edge of town.
Again.
All right. Nothingtown to Fuck-All-Borough!
An inordinate amount of time passes.  It is utterly void of struggle. No ex-wives are contained within it.
Are you sure? You could be closing the door on a brilliant and *special* future for yourself.
Back so soon?
Because, you know, you *are* a murderer. A disco music listening psycho-killer who offs poor people -- and then *forgets* about it.
Blackness, blackness, blackness. The ultimate disco. The ruins of your life behind you, still smouldering. Ashes rise. But you're not looking.
Brother, you already *were* a ghost. Up there, screaming -- along with all of them. Scaring each other. Haunting each other.
Coming right up, sir. Smooth passage...
Do you really?
Do you want me to upgrade that into a *one way trip*, sir?
Don't prod at it, it will start moving again.
Don't tell him, sister. It's too bad.
Ever.
Everyone.
Ex-love, ex-tenderness. It is foolish of you to resurface to the loss. Not after all the damage you suffered to get here, some of it irreversible... Stay, sail with me through the Abyssopelagic Zone!
From what I can see, it's about to BUST A MOVE.
GOD?
GOOD. YOU SHOULD BE.
Good. Because from what I can see, it's about to BUST A MOVE.
Great choice, elder one. It has always been like this -- and it always will.
HERE IT WILL BEGIN.
He's got no idea what he's in for.

Help you, why? I can't hear you, the rest is just a word-dream. Jumbled up garbage. The pictures are gone, the bed rises to meet you. A thin, sleep-like state. More glass than velvet, *grinding* in your head.
How many promises have *you* kept lately, Sir Harry? To the great, see-through world, the tenderness?
How've things been going for you out there? Helped anyone lately? Saved anyone lately? *Murdered* anyone lately?
I knew you couldn't resist. So now you're gonna change the world, but how?
I know you do, baby... I know...
I was wrong to let you go. I should have kept you here... is it bright where you are? Is it TERRIFYING? Have you felt THE LOVE?!
If it comes off like that, it's because it *is*. And you *are*.
Is it? The world is gone, you're no longer reacting to outward stimuli. Yet still...
It was no accident. Those were *disco moves* from your Spinal Cord. The Spinal Cord has yet to reveal itself to you -- its mysteries are unholy mysteries.
It's the *world*, Harry-boy. And you're *made* of it. Every day you're out there you make more of yourself from it. I'm afraid you can't be *unmade* now.
It's the living who are ghosts. The dead are silent. They don't rattle windows or write letters in blood. The living do. Leave them behind. Rest.
It's too late. You're not *made* of nothing anymore, you're something now, Harry. I tried to drown you in the black water but you re-emerged. Kicking and screaming. Running. And for what?
Just another thoughtless vessel ploughing the grey seas of the everyday.
Let it! Let it!

Like a fly to the ointment, your conscience sticks to it. The limbed and headed machine of pain and undignified suffering is firing up again. It wants to walk the desert. Hurting. Longing. Dancing to disco music.
Never ever ever ever, baby!
Never ever.
No reply. There is silence now in the deep where the voice came from. It has receded into you, to return only in dreams and nightmares.
No, you haven't. You've just *been*.
No. NOT GOOD.
No. Relax, man. It's just the comfortable darkness. Interrupted by the pain in your body. A telegraph, far away.
No. This is the one before that. We'll just keep cycling it for you, if you don't mind. As long as we can. Spin it like black yarn.
No. You're spinning tapes at the discotheque. The great, unceasing disco of the mind. The flash! The bang! The endless *learning* experience.
Not you! Your days of giving a shit and being that type of animal are over.
Nothing, sad brother. No treachery. Just blackout.
Nothing. Just the immaculate silence of your spinal fluid. Electrified.

Now, you've gone off the rails, baby, now you're stuck sitting here by the tracks, admiring the wreck around you. You just can't help it: looking at yourself, the sum total of your *accomplishments*...
ORGASMIC!!!
Of course. I know you do. Everybody leaves, when they get the chance. Go on, keep falling. Deeper... take the door.
Of hell and ancient sadness, brother. Ten thousand years later -- in front of the video rental. There is a warm breath on your face again. Everything is *okay* again.
Oh yeah, baby. Frame your suffering as a masterpiece. Only one problem -- no one's watching. It's boring, buddy, boring as death.
Oh yes. *They'll* check you out, give you some pills, make it all okay. The wonder-makers.
Oh, but you *will*. You're already *going* there. Slipping. How long can we keep you from the precipice? *One* more dream? Two max, baby. Then it's...
Oh, don't worry, *the music* is still there. It's *you* who's gone.
On and on it goes, for untold hours. At the disco where you first asked her to dance. Rising -- rising! -- above the dark curvature. The great wingspan of sleep, studded with stars.
Sleep is merciful this time, brother. Not too deep. Lit by the continuous sound of the sea outside.
Somewhere in the sore, bloated man-meat around you -- *a sensation*!
Sure, you do. They're all so friendly, aren't they?
TOTAL DARKNESS! You sink down the darkest fathoms of your own personal deep, vertebrae by vertebrae -- THROUGH THE UNFORMED SKULLS OF YOUR SPINE.
That's me, blue eyes. That's me.
The cool when you're dead, brother.
The song of death is sweet and endless... But what is this? Somewhere in the sore, bloated *man-meat* around you -- a sensation!
There are no days here. There are no weeks. Just black tape spinning. On repeat. Until the end.
There is no Voyager Road. There are no roads. No houses. No lights in the windows. It's all on *pause*.
There is nothing. Only warm, primordial blackness. Your conscience ferments in it -- no larger than a single grain of malt. You don't have to do anything anymore.
There is nothing.
There is silence now in the deep where the voice came from. It has receded -- to return only in dreams and nightmares.
There's no dignity here... only reflections of your body mass. Flashes of the day. You keep coming back to yourself in the mirror -- but why? To admire all your *accomplishments*?
There. No ball of meat, no light in the formless nothing. Just nightswimming!
This is a pivotal moment. Try not to piss yourself.
This is death. One more door, baby. One more door.
This is greatest hits material. Black tape spinning and spinning and spinning... You finally tired yourself. Cornered the flicker of your mind and extinguished it.
This is where the beat plunged. It will resurface soon. Brace for glory.
This respite -- you've earned it, brother. Bask in the darkness. Let it swallow you up and swivel you around while you forget everything you've managed to remember...
Those are the mysteries of the Spinal Cord. The Spinal Cord has yet to reveal itself to you -- its mysteries are unholy mysteries.

Thoughts, baby. A million little lights in the dark. You're one fine instrument, brother -- all those faces and all those names, all that laughter and screaming and scheming around... Every corner and every street...
WHERE IS YOUR GOD?

We're trying to help you. All these processes -- these tortures, voices and tremors -- are all just *distractions*. Flares and countermeasures. To keep you from the *last dream*. The worst of them all.
Well, *almost* nothing. There is the ground below you. That's still there. And the small light that's on -- fluttering -- somewhere in the Basal Ganglia.
Who was what?
Yeah, man, what was that about?
Yeah, man. Fuck *everything*. Total blackout forever.
Yes. It. Is.
You are *way* cool, cooler than the bottom of the sea. Too cool for this world.
You can never forget this shit.
You got it, sweet brother! Nothing upon nothing, upon nothing!
You had your chance, Harry-boy, and you missed it. Started thrashing around, acting all brave -- now the Dark Centre has vanished. You'll never get back to it.
You think they would let you -- until you disintegrate into biomolecules? No, someone is breathing on your face now, inspecting your pupils. Stupid idiot.
You'll be back in those cold snake skins in no time, sweating up the bed...
You'll go insane if you keep going like this. One more day and you'll be in the loonie bin. I just know you will. And for what, brother-man?
You're just stuck here. In the half-world. Could try looking at other people. *Really* looking. But why would you want to start doing that?

You're the son of the World again. Harrister -- a ceaseless agent picking up litter and old newspapers, collecting your little bubble gum wrappers and idiotic picture post cards. Meaningless, meaningless keepsakes.

You're trying to what? I can't hear you, this is just a word-dream now. Jumbled up garbage. The pictures are gone, the bed rises to meet you. A thin sleep-like state. More glass than velvet, *grinding* in your head.
You're welcome, Harry-boy. You earned it.

Your mind is what now? I can't hear you, the rest is just a word-dream. Jumbled up garbage. The pictures are gone, the bed rises to meet you. A thin, sleep-like state. More glass than velvet, *grinding* in your head.
Your name is *fuck all*.

"I would often go there. To the tiny church there. The smallest church in Saint-Saëns -- though it once was larger.

How the rill may rest there. Down through the mist there. Toward the seven sisters -- toward those pale cliffs there

I would often stay there. In the tiny yard there. I have been so glad here -- looking forward to the past here

But now you are alone. None of this matters at all."
"WHO FUCKING CARES?!"
